steps.title: Stripe dashboard
steps.instruction: Open Stripe. For development, turn Test mode ON.

steps.title: API keys
steps.instruction: Copy test (or live) keys into .env. Never commit secret keys.

steps.title: Product and price
steps.instruction: Create a product with a recurring price for your Pro or paid tier.

steps.title: Price ID
steps.instruction: Copy the Price ID (price_...) into .env as STRIPE_PRICE_ID.

steps.title: Webhook endpoint
steps.instruction: Add endpoint URL: {APP_URL}/api/webhooks/stripe (replace {APP_URL} with your Vercel URL).

steps.title: Webhook events
steps.instruction: Subscribe to these events at minimum.

steps.title: Signing secret
steps.instruction: Copy the webhook signing secret into .env as STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
